rationale: 2-point Volt-VAR curve with injection at low voltage (0.94 pu, 0.2 q_fraction) and absorption at high voltage (1.07 pu, -0.3 q_fraction). Interpolated to 0 q_fraction at nominal voltage (1.0 pu). All corrected voltages stay within 0.95-1.05 pu limits and reactive power commands are within inverter capability.
